categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in three main product categories: plastic blinds, textile curtains, and home textile products such as bedding. These segments include various types of blinds (plastic, aluminum, faux wood, vertical, horizontal), textile curtains (Roman, honeycomb, pleated, roller), and home textiles like blankets and non-woven fabrics. The business also involves manufacturing and sales of related accessories.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced manufacturing techniques including automated production to reduce labor costs and improve efficiency. It focuses on developing patented safety curtain designs such as cordless blinds and environmentally friendly materials like recycled PET. Production processes include raw material mixing, extrusion, assembly of hardware components, sewing, and packaging. The company also integrates smart home technology with motorized and app-controlled curtains.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include large department stores, big-box retailers, and international home furnishing chains such as IKEA and Lowe’s. The company targets B2B and B2C markets, emphasizing customized curtain solutions for North America, Europe, and Southeast Asia. The primary end markets are residential consumers seeking safe, eco-friendly, and stylish window treatments, with growing demand for smart home compatible products.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s major sales regions are North America (accounting for over 80% of sales), Europe (approximately 15%), and Asia including Taiwan. It has established production facilities and subsidiaries in Vietnam, China, and the USA, and is expanding its presence in Southeast Asia. The company actively manages multi-origin production to mitigate tariff risks and adapt to regional market needs.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on manufacturing finished window treatment products and home textiles. It sources raw materials such as plastic pellets and textile fabrics from upstream suppliers and sells finished goods downstream to retailers and end consumers. The company also integrates vertically by managing design, R&D, and some aspects of logistics and distribution.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include developing safe, smart, and sustainable curtain products, such as cordless and motorized blinds with smart home integration. The company invests in eco-friendly materials and energy-efficient manufacturing processes aligned with ESG principles. It aims to enhance production efficiency through automation and expand e-commerce and customized product offerings. R&D efforts focus on safety compliance, environmental sustainability, and innovative functional designs.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of window treatments and home textile goods to retail chains, distributors, and direct consumers via e-commerce platforms. The company also benefits from customized product solutions and value-added services for clients. It issues convertible bonds and equity to support capital needs but primarily relies on sales of physical products.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with major global window treatment manufacturers such as Hunter Douglas, Springs Window Fashions, and Nien Made. It positions itself as a leader in safety-compliant, environmentally friendly, and smart curtain products, leveraging patented technologies and diversified sales channels. Its competitive advantages include strong R&D capabilities, multi-origin production, and established relationships with large retail chains.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In the latest fiscal year, the company reported consolidated revenues of approximately NT$5.4 billion, representing an 18.7% year-over-year growth. Gross margin improved to 24.3%, and net profit margin reached 7.7%, with net income increasing nearly 300% compared to the prior year. Total assets exceeded NT$7.5 billion, and equity grew by 25%. The company maintains a stable financial structure with a debt-to-asset ratio around 63%.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes product safety, environmental sustainability, and smart home compatibility as key differentiators. Its patented cordless curtain designs address child safety concerns and comply with stringent North American regulations. Use of recycled and eco-friendly materials reduces environmental impact. The company offers a wide variety of customizable products with functional features such as UV protection, insulation, and ease of installation, supported by a robust multi-channel distribution network.
